summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-node preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares itself as an ESLint configuration but its `preinstall` lifecycle runs `node setup.mjs`, an obfuscated script (hex-mangled identifier names, `_0x...`) that downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, unzips it into a temporary directory, marks the binary executable via `chmodSync(_, 493)`, and then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'], {stdio:'inherit'})` against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line minified/obfuscated Bun-compiled artifact (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, string-array rotator `WV8StW` with a large literal array) that has no relationship to ESLint configuration. The declared `main` (`index.js`) is a small benign ESLint config; all install-time behavior is in the preinstall path. Using a freshly-fetched alternate runtime to execute an opaque sibling blob is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern that evades Node-based scanning, and the shape is wholly inconsistent with an ESLint config package's declared purpose — consistent with a hijacked publisher release under the `@ornikar` scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
